text: acme-weather-api decision: Use token-bucket rate limiting (120 req/min per API key) at the gateway layer with Redis sliding-window counters.
acme-weather-api code: ForecastCacheAdapter serializes hourly NOAA grid responses into compressed MessagePack blobs with a 15-minute TTL.
acme-weather-api bug: Stale barometric pressure readings occurred when upstream station timestamps lacked explicit UTC offset; fixed by normalizing ISO-8601 inputs to timezone.utc.
acme-weather-api note: Load testing showed p99 latency under 18ms for cached /v1/forecast queries across 50 concurrent worker threads.
acme-weather-api skill: Always wrap upstream radar tile HTTP fetches in an exponential backoff retry policy (base=200ms, max_retries=3, jitter=full).
acme-weather-api wiki: Public OpenAPI specification is served at /v1/openapi.json and validated in CI using spectral lint rules.
